usage: xarchive-downloader.exe [-h] [--gallery-dl GALLERY_DL] [--proxy PROXY]
                               [--proxy-mode {system,direct,manual}]
                               [--timeout-seconds TIMEOUT_SECONDS]
                               [--discovery-timeout-seconds DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS]

XArchive Sidecar protocol v2 worker

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --gallery-dl GALLERY_DL
                        path to the gallery-dl executable used for extraction
  --proxy PROXY         optional http(s) proxy applied to gallery-dl child
                        processes
  --proxy-mode {system,direct,manual}
                        how gallery-dl child processes are routed; defaults to
                        XARCHIVE_PROXY_MODE
  --timeout-seconds TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                        per-extraction timeout in seconds
  --discovery-timeout-seconds DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                        per-account discovery timeout in seconds
